summary: The upload-service showed rising memory usage, reaching 85% of its container limit, then critical memory pressure and OOM kill, with corresponding warnings and fatal kernel messages.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:11:33Z ERROR [docker] Container upload-service died with exit code 137 (OOMKilled)
evidence.interpretation: Container termination due to OOM, confirming memory exhaustion.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:11:32Z FATAL [kernel] Out of memory: Kill process 1842 (python) score 982 or sacrifice child
evidence.interpretation: Kernel OOM killer selected the python process, indicating system-wide memory pressure.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:11:00Z ERROR [upload-service] System memory pressure critical: 990MB resident
evidence.interpretation: Upload-service reported critical memory usage shortly before OOM events.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:09:00Z WARN [upload-service] Memory usage at 85% of container limit (850MB / 1024MB)
evidence.interpretation: Early warning of high memory consumption, preceding critical pressure.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:40Z WARN [upload-service] [s3-client] AWS STS temporary credentials renewal check scheduled - distractor
evidence.interpretation: Unrelated warning, likely not connected to memory issue.
